name: Air Force Engineering University
zh: 中国人民解放军空军工程大学
aliases: China People’s Liberation Army Air Force Engineering University

evidence.summary: CASI describes Air Force Engineering University, formed in Xi’an in 1999 from the PLA Air Force’s engineering, missile and telecommunications engineering colleges, as one of the PLA’s comprehensive universities, reporting to PLA Air Force headquarters. The US Commerce Department added it to the Entity List in 2025 as one of 27 Chinese entities it found had acquired or tried to acquire US-origin items in support of China’s military modernisation.
The university reports to PLA Air Force headquarters.
